sloka: तेन त्यक्ताः त्रयो बाणाः शिताः शत्रु निबर्हणाः ।विकृष्य सुमहत् चापम् सुपर्ण अनिल तुल्य गाः ॥३-३९-११॥
transliteration: tena tyaktāḥ trayo bāṇāḥ śitāḥ śatru nibarhaṇāḥ ।vikṛṣya sumahat cāpam suparṇa anila tulya gāḥ ॥3-39-11॥

translations.english: All the three tightly jointed, welltargetted darts, strong as thunderbolt, and which could feed on blood came together all at once.
